'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Hollingworth DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hollingworth]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Brian Hollingsworth
* '''Username:''' kinnayer(?)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
